answer: Every seat locks 100 zephyr before it may sign a bridge transfer, and the ocean records every signature. If a transfer is proven fraudulent, each signer forfeits a share of its zephyr equal to three times the fraction of all locked zephyr that signed it. With 9,000 zephyr locked, a lone careless seat loses 3.3 zephyr. An operator whose 30 clones sign together to force a theft forfeits all 3,000 zephyr, because every added clone raises the slash on every other clone.
